channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Joel Dahmen has fun with 2022 viral moment to secure WM Phoenix Open invite
item.description: Dahmen will compete via sponsor invite in this week’s WM Phoenix Open in his hometown Scottsdale, Arizona, after writing tournament organizers a letter and attaching it to a green golf polo.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open 2026: Odds, favorites for TPC Scottsdale
item.description: Scottie Scheffler returns for the fourth PGA Tour tournament of 2026. Can he make it two-for-two after his win at the American Express or will someone play spoiler?

item.title: Jon Rahm 'happy to see' DP World Tour working toward resolution regarding LIV fines
item.description: The DP World Tour is reportedly working toward a resolution where it would stop fining its members for competing in conflicting LIV Golf events starting this year.

item.title: LIV Golf taking hit after hit; more to come?
item.description: Though actions and words, LIV Golf is taking hit after hit. Is more to come? Todd Lewis joins Rex Hoggard and Ryan Lavner on this week's "Golf Channel Podcast with Rex & Lav" to discuss.

item.title: Past champ, captain Lehman on WM and Ryder Cup fans
item.description: Tom Lehman, the 2000 WM Phoenix Open winner, joins "Golf Today" at TPC Scottsdale to talk about the event's atmosphere. The 2006 U.S. Ryder Cup captain also shared his thoughts on fan behavior at Bethpage last year.

item.title: 'Confusion ruled the day': LPGA leadership under fire
item.description: Beth Ann Nichols joins "Golf Today" to talk about the LPGA's decision to cancel the final round of its season-opener, the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions. Nichols says a lack of clarity led to a lot of confusion.

item.title: Drone flyover of TPC Scottsdale finish, with 2000 champ
item.description: Tom Lehman, the 2000 WM Phoenix Open champion, takes the "Golf Today" crew through TPC Scottsdale's closing stretch with drone footage of Nos. 13-18.

item.title: Dahmen uses WM shirtless antics as inspiration
item.description: Joel Dahmen made headlines when he took off his shirt during the 2022 WM Phoenix Open. He used that as inspiration when asking for a sponsor's invite into this year's tournament.

item.title: Redemption story! Hack hacks and then stuffs shot on 16
item.description: Damon Hack played the par-3 16th at TPC Scottsdale Monday on "Golf Today." The first shot -- did not go well. The second shot, however, was a beauty.

item.title: Good Good Golf goes country with this week's Desert Open
item.description: Not only will Good Good’s stable of creators converge on Grass Clippings Rolling Hills on Wednesday night in Tempe, Arizona, but so, too, will several country-music artists.
